candidates.description: These tokens represent characters, vowel signs, and common morphophonemic components from the Devanagari script used for Hindi and Sanskrit.
This feature vector activates on Hindi vowel-sign combinations and diphthongs that frequently occur in word-medial and word-final positions.
This vector activates on Hindi characters, vowel signs, and common sub-word tokens within Devanagari script.
This vector is related to Indic script characters, diacritics, and conjunct consonants, particularly within Brahmic writing systems like Devanagari.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Devanagari letter 'व' (va) and its various vowel and consonant conjuncts.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi subword tokens and Devanagari character fragments.
This feature vector activates on Hindi character n-grams and sub-word root fragments.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel matras attached to punctuation marks or commas.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters, conjuncts, and sub-syllabic text components.
